text: Steenbarger: I ratify reclaim:ma_20 on H1, the trigger as written. elder_5d [10, 10, 10, 10, 10] is a plateau, labelled C24 (unsourced): summer, not the buying season (C20), so I will not buy the extension; the entry is the return to value under a rising trend (C10), W 9>21, D HH/HL, mp 93.0. The four objections each ask to buy strength or need a different test; none shows me a transition or a red bar, so I hold. Wrong on impulse red (elder_le:1) or a daily close under ma_50. What would move me: a fresh permission event in elder_5d (a bar 6 or under, then 7+).
